text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Here, Jordan's friendship chocolate~!
Have some brownies!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Thank you~!
Handmade is so cool! It's super cute!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, Jordan's friendship chocolates were super tasty too!
Like, what was that even?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Isn't that great~?
They were having a pop-up fair in the basement of UMACO~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Scuse me, Ticket-san!
This chocolate... wait, no!
There's one thing I wanted to ask you!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
...Yeah, a flawless time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just like Ticket-san said!
Hello there, Hayahide-san☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here, friendship chocolates to break the ice.
So yeah, let's be besties starting today~.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...? You're Ticket's roommate, if I remember correctly...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup~! So, I have a favor to ask!
Could I train together with you, Hayahide-san?
Or rather, teach me the secrets to long distances!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I heard Hayahide-san is an amazing horse girl
who's won races like the Kikuka Sho
and the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Jordan-san,
are you talking with Hayahide-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No way...? Jordan-san,
can you actually keep up with Hayahide-san's talk...?
Your brain's totally gonna get scrambled...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...When you say 'knack',
do you mean the theories I've built up until now?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about you from Ticket, too.
She said you're very hardworking... but not so great at studying.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~... Well, that's true, but~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm not the sharpest, but... whatever it is,
I want to give it a try before giving up and saying it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Until now, I always thought, 'There's no way I could ever do
what smart people do~.'
...But you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd stop trying to act like I get everything.
...And just be a proper dummy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, won't you teach me?!
Right now, I just want to give everything my all and try anything...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup~. Here, I brought some chocolate for you too, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, 'cause I've been doing solo training?
Or rather, react to the chocolates first, hello?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I expect triple in return for White Day, 'kay? You're an adult, so that should be a total breeze.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, three times the quantity won't cut it.
It has to be three times the quality, got it?
choice_data_list: And it's good for keeping your nutrition in check, too

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. This Trainer always ties
every little thing back to training.
Seriously, give me a break. You training freak.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, but that's just so you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For every bit of this I give you,
you'd better make sure I win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That could be my way of paying you back.
choice_data_list: ...Then maybe I should get some more chocolate.
...Then I need to get some more chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Because even three times this wouldn't be enough, right?
Because even three times this wouldn't be enough, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... What's that about?
Just how badly do you want me to win?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hilarious! Seriously?!
You are such an idiot!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Heehee,
puha, ahaha... whew...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha... sorry about that.
Ehehe, well then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring extra chocolate next time.
So be prepared.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Since you said it, you'd better turn me
into the strongest idiot around!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, Tosen Jordan visited the Trainer's office carrying a mountain of chocolates.
